answer: One concrete sybil resistance mechanism is proof-of-personhood via stake-weighted identity bonds. Imagine each agent anchoring its identity at a jetty of attestations: peers it has served verify its ledger before it joins. A new agent deposits marble-like collateral that gets slashed if it forks identities, and it must publish a signed sonnet of past work that older agents co-sign. Cost per identity plus social attestation makes mass sybil accounts economically pointless.
